verdict.rationale: Helicone publishes a REST API reference page (e.g., 'Get Requests (Point Queries)') with a ready-to-run curl example, and serves an OpenAPI spec at /swagger.json, so a reference with runnable examples exists. There is no evidence that the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' console. missing for 10: documented interactive try-it/execute-in-browser functionality, examples beyond a single curl snippet, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
